basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a recent college graduate currently working as a junior graphic designer in Portland, Oregon. I have a strong interest in retro technology, particularly MiniDisc players, which I collect and sometimes restore. I also enjoy keeping fit, so I'm following the StrongLifts 5x5 program, which I find very rewarding. In my downtime, I listen to old Ron and Fez shows while tinkering with my gadgets. I'm single and usually online during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor’s degree in Visual Arts, which has given me a solid foundation in design principles. My interest in MiniDisc technology came from a high school project, and I've been self-teaching through online forums and YouTube tutorials ever since. My fitness journey is largely driven by online resources and fitness communities.
